style.toneOfVoice: Celebrate in heroic style with this exciting Keepsake hanging ornament featuring Wolverine, the iconic hero from Marvel and X-Men. Perfect as a Christmas or birthday gift, or for adding to your Marvel collection. Made from hard-wearing resin, this detailed ornament showcases Marvel s ferocious Wolverine with his claws extended. Simply add a loop of twine, ribbon or thread (not included) to the metal ring to hang and display this collectible keepsake in your home. It s the perfect Christmas tree decoration or gift for Wolverine and X-Men fans. Hallmark Ornaments are a great way to commemorate hobbies, life events and individual interests in movies, games and more. Ornament Measures: H9.5cm by W8.3cm by D8.7cm. This is not a toy. For decorative use only. Dimensions(mm): Height: 95 Width: 83 Depth: 87.
